description: Visual settings panel, status bar and patch guard for Antigravity-Proxy (restores version.dll after IDE updates)
command.restartIde: Restart IDE to Apply Proxy Settings
config.language: Display language of the extension. "auto" follows the IDE display language.
config.autoRestore: After an IDE auto-update removes `version.dll` / `config.json`, restore them automatically at startup from the copy bundled with the extension (`config.json` is restored to your last saved settings first). Restart the IDE afterwards to apply.
config.statusBarEnabled: Show the proxy status in the status bar (click to open proxy settings).
config.probeInterval: Interval in seconds for the status bar proxy port check; 0 checks only at startup and after saving.
